description:

About ADS

ADS is the UK trade association for the aerospace, defence, security and space sectors, representing more than 2,000 member organisations across the UK. We support businesses of all sizes through policy advocacy, market intelligence, networking opportunities, business development support and industry-leading events. Our members range from major multinational organisations to innovative SMEs, all contributing to the success and growth of the UK's advanced engineering and technology sectors.

The Membership Team sits at the heart of ADS, leading member engagement, recruitment and retention activities across the organisation. Working collaboratively with colleagues from across the business, the team is responsible for delivering value to members through events, communications, account management and business development initiatives.

The Role

We are seeking a highly organised, professional and proactive Personal Assistant to provide dedicated support to the ADS Membership Director and Head of SME Engagement. This is a key role within a busy and dynamic team, requiring exceptional organisational skills, sound judgement and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

As a trusted member of the team, you will play a central role in ensuring the efficient management of senior leadership activities. You will coordinate complex diaries, manage meeting arrangements, prepare high-quality documentation and act as an important point of contact for members, colleagues and external stakeholders. Working with a high degree of confidentiality and professionalism, you will help ensure priorities are delivered effectively and that leaders are fully prepared for meetings, events and engagements.

The role also supports the wider Membership Team, contributing to the delivery of membership services and helping to ensure ADS continues to provide exceptional value and engagement opportunities for its members. Occasional travel and attendance at events may be required.

What You'll Be Doing

In this varied role, you will provide comprehensive executive support to two senior leaders, managing diaries, coordinating meetings and organising travel arrangements. You will prepare agendas, presentations, reports, briefing papers and correspondence, ensuring information is accurate, professional and delivered within agreed timeframes. You will also

monitor actions arising from meetings and projects, following up with stakeholders to ensure progress and completion.

You will support the coordination of training sessions and meetings relating to ADS's CRM project, liaising with external providers and internal stakeholders as required. In addition, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate records within the CRM system, managing expense submissions and supporting the smooth operation of the wider Membership Team.

Building strong relationships will be an important part of the role. You will regularly engage with members, senior leaders, colleagues, external partners and representatives from industry and government organisations, acting as a trusted and professional liaison on behalf of the Membership Director and Head of SME Engagement.

About You

You will have previous experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant or in a senior administrative support role, with a proven ability to manage busy workloads and competing priorities. You will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail, organisation and discretion are essential.

You will possess excellent communication skills and be confident interacting with stakeholders at all levels. Strong experience preparing reports, briefing packs, presentations and business correspondence is important, as is the ability to manage complex diaries, coordinate meetings and oversee travel arrangements.

A strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams, is required. Experience using CRM systems or managing databases would be advantageous. Most importantly, you will be proactive, adaptable and able to build productive working relationships while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and confidentiality.

Why Join ADS?

This is an excellent opportunity to join an influential organisation operating at the forefront of the aerospace, defence, security and space sectors. You will work closely with senior leaders, engage with a broad network of industry stakeholders and play an important role in supporting a function that sits at the heart of member engagement and business growth.

If you are an experienced Personal Assistant looking for a varied and rewarding role where you can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.

title: Patient Administrator
description: University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust is delighted to offer a fantastic opportunity to work with us. Please see below for detailed job description of the role. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment? Are you passionate about delivering exceptional administrative support that enhances the patient experience and journey? We are seeking a range of Patient Administrators, Patient Services Centre Administrators and Ward Secretaries to join our Trust. These roles are essential to the seamless operation of our services and have a significant impact on our patients' experiences. Your responsibilities will be varied and include direct communication with patients and healthcare professionals, coordinating appointment bookings, managing correspondence and actions from outpatient clinics, and ensuring the smooth flow of information between clinicians and support services. UHS offers outstanding training and development opportunities to help you achieve your career aspirations. Supporting the growth of our staff is fundamental to delivering high-quality, safe, and effective care. We provide a nurturing environment for professional development, and internal applicants looking to gain experience in different roles or areas of the hospital may be considered for secondment opportunities. Ward Secretary This is an excellent opportunity for an organised individual with attention to detail and proficiency in Microsoft Office, who is eager to collaborate with various nursing professionals and the wider multidisciplinary team (MDT). Full-time and part-time positions are available. Main Responsibilities: Collaborate closely with ward leaders to provide administrative support in cancer care. Prepare documentation, communicate with stakeholders, and use Microsoft 365 to organise and schedule meetings on behalf of the Line Manager. Deliver exceptional customer service by providing a professional telephone service, taking accurate messages, and offering information and guidance as appropriate. Patient Administrator We are looking for highly motivated and proactive individuals to join our busy department as Patient Administrators. In this role, you will build strong relationships with consultants, administrative teams, nursing staff, and external providers, ensuring a smooth patient pathway through the department. Strong written and verbal communication skills, along with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team, are essential. You will also provide cross-cover for other administrators to maintain consistent and effective administration services. Working closely with your team of consultants, your duties will vary but will include direct communication with patients and healthcare professionals, arranging appointments, managing correspondence from outpatient clinics, and facilitating the flow of information among clinicians and support services. Full-time and part-time positions are available. Confidently use Microsoft systems, working with minimal supervision and demonstrating a tactful, sensitive approach to challenging situations. Exhibit empathy and excellent communication skills, acting as the first point of contact by handling telephone calls, emails, and visitors, by responding promptly and efficiently to queries, or redirecting them to the appropriate person/department. Thrive under pressure and prioritise your workload effectively. Collaborate with a large team, demonstrating flexibility in multitasking and covering for colleagues as needed. Communicate effectively with ward teams, matrons, divisional nursing staff, consultants, ward administrators, and patients. Familiarity with the Trust's electronic systems is advantageous but not essential, as training will be provided. Patient Services Administrator We approach our conversations with patients with compassion and respect, recognising that this is a particularly challenging time for them. We seek candidates who are empathetic and capable of handling difficult conversations. If you are resilient and proactive, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and respond to urgent requests from our stakeholders while meeting tight deadlines, we want to hear from you. Effective communication with care groups is essential to inform them of any capacity issues or patients at risk of breaching, as well as attending weekly meetings and following the necessary escalation procedures. This role requires close attention to detail and the ability to quickly assimilate information. Full-time and part-time positions are available. The Outpatient Administrator Centre (OAC) staff are dedicated and hardworking, often serving as the first point of contact for patients. Their responsibilities include: Handling approximately 20,000 calls each month from patients. Booking over 650,000 outpatient appointments annually, across 50 specialties within the Trust. Managing clinic schedules, rescheduling, and cancelling appointments, and filling new clinic slots. Covering reception desks at all our locations, checking patients in, scheduling follow-up appointments, and addressing queries. Preparing patient packs for outpatient clinics. Our service operates from 7am to 6pm - Monday to Friday and from 8am to 4:30pm on Saturdays. You will be expected to work flexibly within these core hours. There are roles across the Trust, including in care groups such as Surgery, Outpatient Administration Centre, Pharmacy, Cancer Care and more. Please indicate in your application if there is an area that you would be particularly interested in.
